statement:
Let $a\in\mathbb{R}^m_{+}$ and $b\in\mathbb{R}^n_{+}$ be probability vectors, and let $K\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}_{+}$ have strictly positive entries. The relaxed Sinkhorn iteration is
\[
u_{\ell+1}=u_\ell^{1-\omega}\circ\left(\frac{a}{Kv_\ell}\right)^\omega,
\qquad
v_{\ell+1}=v_\ell^{1-\omega}\circ\left(\frac{b}{K^{\mathsf T}u_{\ell+1}}\right)^\omega,
\]
with componentwise operations. Define
\[
\eta(K)=\max_{i,j,k,\ell}\frac{K_{ik}K_{j\ell}}{K_{jk}K_{i\ell}},
\qquad
\Lambda(K)=\frac{\sqrt{\eta(K)}-1}{\sqrt{\eta(K)}+1},
\]
and
\[
\delta_1=\frac{a_{\min}}{b_{\max}}\,\frac{1-b_{\max}}{\left(\frac{\lVert K\rVert_\infty}{\sigma_{\min}(K)}\right)^2-a_{\min}}>0,
\qquad
\delta_2=\frac{b_{\min}}{a_{\max}}\,\frac{1-a_{\max}}{\left(\frac{\lVert K^{\mathsf T}\rVert_\infty}{\sigma_{\min}(K)}\right)^2-b_{\min}}>0,
\]
where $\sigma_{\min}(K)$ is the smallest positive singular value of $K$, $\lVert K\rVert_\infty=\max_{\lVert v\rVert_\infty=1}\lVert Kv\rVert_\infty$, and the subscripts $\min$ and $\max$ denote the smallest and largest entries of the corresponding vector. Set
\[
\delta_{K,a,b}=\begin{cases}
\delta_1,&m>n,\\
\delta_2,&m<n,\\
\max(\delta_1,\delta_2),&m=n.
\end{cases}
\]
If $\operatorname{rank}(K)=\min(m,n)\ge 2$, then for every
\[
1<\omega<\min\left(1+\delta_{K,a,b},\frac{2}{1+\Lambda(K)}\right),
\]
the modified method is globally convergent and asymptotically faster than the standard Sinkhorn method.

Let \(\Omega\subset\mathbb R^2\) be a bounded convex polygonal domain. Assume \(K\in H^2(\Omega)\) is strictly positive on \(\overline\Omega\), \(\phi\in H^4(\Omega)\) is strictly convex, and the prescribed Gaussian curvature problem
\[
\det D^2u=K(x)(1+|Du|^2)^2\quad\text{in }\Omega,\qquad u=\phi\quad\text{on }\partial\Omega
\]
has a strictly convex solution \(u\in H^4(\Omega)\). Let \(V_h\) be the finite element space based on the enhanced cubic Lagrange element, let \(\phi_h\) be the one-dimensional cubic Lagrange interpolant of \(\phi\) on \(\partial\Omega\), and define
\[
L_h=\left\{v\in V_h:\ v=\phi_h\text{ on }\partial\Omega,\ \operatorname{tr}(J_T^{\mathsf T}D_h^2v\,J_T)\ge 0\text{ at the vertices of }T^\dagger\text{ for every }T\in\mathcal T_h\right\}.
\]
The discrete problem is to find
\[
u_h\in\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{v\in L_h}J_h(v),
\]
where
\[
J_h(v)=\frac12\left\|\det D_h^2v-K(1+|D_hv|^2)^2\right\|_{L^2(\Omega)}^2+C_h(v),
\]
and \(C_h\) contains regularization and penalization terms chosen so that the objective function is coercive.
